# MadeOfPixels Studio
> Web design agency in Vasai and Mumbai. We build custom websites, brand identities, UI/UX designs and digital products — hand-coded from scratch, zero templates.

## About
MadeOfPixels Studio is a web design agency based in Vasai West, Maharashtra, India. Founded by a team of engineers and designers, we serve businesses across Vasai, Virar, Mumbai, Thane, and Navi Mumbai. Every project is built from scratch — no WordPress themes, no page builders, no templates.

## Services
- Web Design & Development: Custom HTML/CSS/JS websites, React/Next.js apps, landing pages, CMS integration
- Brand Identity: Logo design, brand guidelines, typography systems, visual language
- UI/UX Design: SaaS interfaces, admin dashboards, client portals, digital products
- Graphic Design: Posters, social media kits, packaging, motion design
